[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

'''⚠️ Paleographic Warning:'''

This profile is based on a testament written in 17th-century Secretary Hand. Due to the ornate and inconsistent handwriting style, all names, places, and relationships should be considered '''tentative''' and subject to '''revision''' pending further document comparison or corroboration. Interpretations are paleographically informed but speculative.

== Biography ==
''This profile is a placeholder for a 17th-century Glasgow individual from Lanarkshire, possibly the son of [[Glasgow-3019|John Glasgow (abt.1610–bef.1653)]], and part of an early Glasgow family line based near Biggar.''

This man was active in '''Quothquan''' parish, in the rural uplands west of '''Biggar''', on the Lanarkshire–Peeblesshire border.

He is identified in the '''13 July 1662''' testament dative of John Glasgow as his '''lawful son and executor dative'''. The estate was confirmed in the '''Lanark Commissary Court''' (CC14/5/6), where he gave oath and produced an inventory of goods. A man named '''James Glasgow''', described as John’s brother, also appeared and gave assurance.

This individual was the same '''John Glasgow''' who appears again in a separate testament dative dated '''25 March 1685''' (CC14/5/12), also in Quothquan, suggesting he survived his father by several decades and managed property in the same location.

He may have been born between '''1630 and 1635''', which would make him old enough to serve as legal executor in 1662. No spouse or children are yet confirmed.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1086]] is assessed at 21% (uncertain). The inherited account makes John the lawful son and executor in a 1662 testament and equates him with the 1685 Quothquan decedent. The reviewed readings do not establish that chain: the 1685 record does not prove a child, and the 1662 record-defined John has been conflated with another account.

Uncertain 21%; the existing father is preserved, while the actual kin term and cross-testament identity remain unverified.

Next useful test: Re-read the exact 1662 executor and kinship clause against the original.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3331 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-3331]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.


=== Current research ===

No reviewed record identifies Glasgow-1498 or Glasgow-2731 as this John's sons. His own biography says no children are confirmed. The published Lanark index also contains separate John Glasgow testament entries dated 1650, 1662 and 1685; their identities must not be collapsed from the index alone. Glasgow-3019 now redirects to attached father [[Glasgow-1086]]. Reinspection of CC14/5/12 shows that the 1685 John had widow Jonet (surname provisionally Kinnie), but the record names no child. It therefore does not prove this father-son edge.

This assessment draws on the cited records and public source material.<ref name="ProjectSource1">[https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/search-records/legal-records/wills ScotlandsPeople wills].</ref>
